title: Generate the FHIR Shorthand and build it with SUSHI
description: Writes one FSH Logical per data-dictionary sheet (51; FHIR types from the I2CE field types, cardinality from optionality, an extensible binding to the field's ValueSet, and a Mapping back to each I2CE field name), runs the pinned SUSHI over src/ihris-4-on-fhir and fails unless it is clean, and writes the terminology JSON from SUSHI's build (D8: build_dak.py writes the terminology as FSH). --check: the logical-model FSH is current, SUSHI is clean, and the committed terminology JSON is exactly SUSHI's build.

inputs.name: terminology
inputs.description: Read from src/ihris-data-dictionary/terminology/ (and written there, from the SUSHI build)

outputs.name: terminology
outputs.description: Written to src/ihris-data-dictionary/terminology/ from the SUSHI build
